best_lineage.idea: Implement a cache-blocking (tiling) optimization with a micro-kernel that processes 8x8 tiles to improve data locality and enable the compiler to vectorize the inner loops more effectively on Apple Silicon.

Replace the scalar inner loop with an explicit NEON micro-kernel that processes 8 rows of C and 8 columns of B at a time using 8x8 register tiling, which significantly improves memory bandwidth utilization and allows the CPU to hide latency by keeping data in registers during the k-loop.
